Smartly refresh widgets when the phone returns to the desktop.

After enabling this feature, you can enhance your experience of using the "Magic Widgets". For example: 1. When you use the Magic Picture widget to add GIF animation or a slideshow, the Magic widget will immediately play the GIF animation and slideshow when you return to the desktop. It will automatically stop playing when you leave the desktop or lock the screen. 2. When you use the Magic Screen Assistant widget, it will refresh the latest mobile usage time record immediately when you return to the desktop, allowing you to understand your mobile usage in real-time. 3. When you use the Magic Phrase widget, it will update the phrase more intelligently when you return to the desktop. 4. When you use the Magic Application Recommendation widget, it will update the recommended application list more intelligently when you return to the desktop. 5. When you use the Magic Countdown widget, it will refresh the countdown time more intelligently when you return to the desktop. Warm tip: This function will not increase the power consumption of the phone or affect the use of the phone (it has been tested that the power consumption generated in the case of adding 100 magic widgets to the desktop in a day can be ignored), please use it with confidence.
